title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B
variant: NVIDIA 24GB checkpoint, fp8 KV, DFlash drafter
summary: The model card's vLLM command for Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B (24GB) on one 32 GB RTX 5090, changed only where a 32 GB card needs it, with three profiles: fast, long and multi.

configs.label: fast
configs.notes: DFlash LiLiCorr drafter, 5 tokens, GPU mem util 0.95. Power limit 408 W, stock clocks, fp8 KV, warm runs. Decode is about 218 tok/s: medians of 8 runs on 3 boots were 226, 213, 217.

configs.label: long
configs.notes: No drafter, GPU mem util 0.96. Power limit 408 W, stock clocks, fp8 KV, warm runs. 196K prefill 4,460-4,490 tok/s.

configs.label: multi
configs.notes: No drafter, 8 sequences, GPU mem util 0.88 with VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS=0. Power limit 408 W, stock clocks, fp8 KV, warm runs, 512-token decode, all requests started at once. The 4-request figures were measured with 4 sequences; with 8 sequences 4 requests give 429-434 tok/s total.
